newsitem.title: USA: Puget,Wash. Energy decision seen next week.
newsitem.headline: Puget,Wash. Energy decision seen next week.

text.p: State regulators will decide next week to accept or reject the planned merger of Puget Sound Power and Light Co and Washington Energy Co, a spokeswoman for the Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission (WUTC) in Olympia said Monday.
The commission will rule on a stipulated settlement made late last year between Puget Power, Washington Energy, the staff of the WUTC and the state attorney general's office.
A total of 19 parties have made filings at the commission regarding the merger.
The settlement includes a five-year rate plan, but does not include an authorized rate of return for the merged utility.
A decision from the WUTC, which can accept, reject or modify the settlement, is expected next Monday or Tuesday, the commission spokeswoman said.
"We are hopeful they will make a decision we can move forward with," said a spokeswoman for Puget Power.
